query: Build out the guide for MD-1905 — it's a Pillar ticket linking a Confluence draft, publish it to /resources/guides.
expected_behavior: Runs the marketing-pages repo guard and derives a descriptive lowercase-hyphenated slug, confirming it before uploading
Fetches the Confluence draft and delegates the storage-to-markdown transform to a Sonnet subagent

Composes a hand-written Vue page at pages/resources/guides/<slug>.vue from the guide component palette (SectionHeroProduct, NavPillarSubnav, BaseSection, DisplayFeatureCard, SectionAccordion) rather than a Nuxt-Content markdown file
Uploads body images to guides/<slug>/ and an OG image to og/, generates a card thumbnail as guide-<NN>.webp, and appends a new entry to the guides array in index.vue
Verifies the route renders on this worktree's dev server, confirms the index card appears, and cleans up sources
